The mechanism likely involves Selgantolimod interacting with the hemagglutinin antigen to influence its activity, and simultaneously affecting fructose-bisphosphate aldolase A, possibly through a shared cellular pathway or regulatory mechanism. The evidence supports a plausible biological link, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact nature of the interaction and its functional significance.
